# SayDone AI authoring V1

Start here: docs/authoring/AI_START_HERE.md
Machine-readable manifest: docs/authoring/AI_AUTHORING_MANIFEST_V1.json
Ordinary-chat protocol: docs/authoring/AUTHORING_CHAT_PROTOCOL_V1.md
Primitive guide: docs/authoring/AUTHORING_PRIMITIVES_V1.md

Use only the contract pages selected by the manifest. The supported source path is
SayDoneAuthoringBundleV1 -> preview/RepairReportV1 -> checksum-bound
SayDoneAuthoringPatchV1 -> trusted confirmation and loader. Do not author a
BotPackage directly for the ordinary AI path.
